output.headline: Northgate Rovers Edge Southmere United 1‑0
output.text: Northgate opened strongly, a 10.9‑metre carry by Andres Vega (e0116) spurring early pressure. Southmere answered with Rafa Ortega’s 10‑metre burst (e0221) and an interception at 19’ (e0341). The decisive moment came at 23’: Emre Kaya’s 30.1‑metre pass (difficulty 48) found Oscar Blum, who struck a 4.3‑metre, 101.4 km/h effort (xG 0.472) for the only goal (e0426‑e0428). Southmere’s wing play generated a 41‑metre, high‑difficulty pass (e0713) but failed to break the deadlock. Late chances included Blum’s off‑target shot (e1205) and a final‑minute carry by Bruno Costa (e1697). Northgate’s patient possession (55% possession, xG 1.18, PPDA 8.3) and superior interception count (42) secured the win (e1784).
